tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_agent_jobs AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.job_type, src.contact_id, src.status, src.created_at, src.updated_at FROM (
SELECT 
  id,
  organization_id,
  job_type,
  contact_id,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM (
  SELECT id, organization_id, 'enrichment' AS job_type, contact_id, status::text AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM crm.lead_enrichment_jobs WHERE organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, organization_id, 'scoring' AS job_type, contact_id, status::text AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM crm.lead_scoring_jobs WHERE organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, organization_id, 'nurture' AS job_type, contact_id, status::text AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM crm.lead_nurture_jobs WHERE organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, organization_id, 'lifecycle' AS job_type, contact_id, status::text AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM crm.lead_lifecycle_jobs WHERE organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) aj
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT job_type, status, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS job_count FROM rpt_agent_jobs AS agent_jobs WHERE TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY job_type, status ORDER BY job_type, status LIMIT 500
